name: Publication harvest: every mention of a covered company, retrieved with its provenance, kept as received, structured without loss, and graded by strength over time -- the Chatter axis and the company event spine.
description: Retrieval, structure and the bronze/silver/gold build for the publication channels (Seeking Alpha, Bloomberg.com, Barron's, WSJ, FT) that feed AMGT_RESAPP's Chatter axis and news. Runs beside AMGT_RESAPP and does not own that project's page, trial or other channels.
